emotional_tone: Authority, Precision, Advanced Technology, Enterprise Trust

font_families.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Chivo (fallback: sans-serif)
font_families.body: Satoshi, Inter, or IBM Plex Sans (fallback: sans-serif)

anti_patterns: Do not use text-7xl or above for headings.
Never center text by default; use explicit alignment.

rules: Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI must be monochrome (shades of deep grey to stark white).
Use Accent Primary (#002FA7) strictly for primary actions, active states, and structural highlights.
Never use pure #000000; base is #050505 (Tinted deep void).
No full-screen gradients. Use solid dark backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Bento Grid (TETRIS mode for Marketing, CONTROL ROOM for Dashboards)
spacing_scale: Generous padding: Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for sections.
Tight internal gap: gap-4 to gap-8 for bento children.
alignment: Asymmetry: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, varying column spans (col-span-4 vs col-span-8).

surface_styles.cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look) - border-collapse style layout, sharp edges, 1px subtle borders (border-zinc-800).
surface_styles.headers: Crystal Glass - backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, 1px bottom border-white/10.
surface_styles.buttons: Sharp corners or minimal radius (rounded-md), high-contrast text.

rules: Animations must be purposeful, minimal, and highly responsive.
Hover states: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1), border color changes, text color brightens.
Focus states: High contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500).
Entry animations: Fast staggered fades for bento grid children (using Framer Motion).

components_instructions.strategy: Hybrid Approach: Pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing structures, Shadcn for interactive logic.
components_instructions.buttons: Solid stark white with black text for primary (or Accent Blue with white text). Minimal radius.
components_instructions.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: border darkens, slight lift.
components_instructions.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized to dark mode. Dark inputs, stark white text, sharp focus rings.
components_instructions.navigation: Sticky glass header (z-50). Visible links on desktop, hamburger strictly on mobile.

visual_enhancers.textures: Grain/Noise overlays on dark backgrounds to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' - Low contrast dark ribbons with uppercase monospaced text, moving very slowly.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay from black/70 via black/40 to transparent to ensure text contrast over hero visuals.

hero_images.description: Server racks highlighting modern technology infrastructure. Use for Orchestra IQ or Home Hero.
Woman in server room. Use for Careers or Team page.

logos.description: Slack logo - use in partner/client logo bento grid.
Mercedes Benz emblem - use in enterprise client showcase.
Pexels logo - use in trusted network section.

team_photos.description: Business team. Use in About Us.
Business consulting. Use for Expert Network.

rules: If more logos/images are needed, creatively repurpose these or use high-quality Lucide icons to represent concepts.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='nav-link-products').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup fonts: Use next/font or @fontsource to install Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, and JetBrains Mono. If unavailable, use Outfit (headings), Inter (body), and Roboto Mono.
2. Setup Lucide-React for all icons. Avoid standard generic SVGs.
3. Scaffold the exact pages requested: Home, About Us, Products Hub, Orchestra IQ, Arjun AI, Blog, Contact, Careers, Expert Network.
4. Component Architecture: Create reusable Layout grids (Bento), but avoid over-componentizing marketing structures. Use Shadcn strictly for Forms, Modals, Menus, Accordions.
5. Supabase/Forms: Setup mock/UI state for forms (Contact, Lead, Newsletter, Expert Network). Ensure error/success states are styled in dark mode.
6. Adhere strictly to the Dark Mode Swiss Brutalist aesthetic. Do not introduce stray colors. Maintain high contrast.
7. Implement Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveal animations in bento grids.
8. Ensure the header is sticky and mobile responsive.
9. Add data-testid to every clickable item, form input, and key informational card.
